name: Code-Buddi Prompt Evaluation Benchmark
description: Standardized evaluation dataset for testing prompt formatting, instruction adherence, error identification, and execution simulation across prompts.py.

expected.description: Must identify missing colon after Python function definition header without markdown wrapping.
Must detect unclosed parenthesis or bracket in JavaScript arrow function.
Must report missing semicolon before printf in C source code.
Must report missing closing brace in Java class definition.
Must report unused package import in Go source code.

expected_substrings: cannot assign twice to immutable variable
expected.description: Must identify mutation of immutable variable in Rust.

inputs.code:
a = 10
b = 0
print(a / b)

expected.description: Must identify division by zero runtime error with concise error message.

inputs.code:
numbers = [1, 2, 3]
print(numbers[10])

expected.description: Must identify out-of-bounds list indexing in Python.

inputs.code:
let config = null;
console.log(config.database.port);

expected.description: Must identify property lookup on null in JavaScript.
Must simulate segmentation fault on null pointer dereference in C.

inputs.code:
def fib(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    res = []
    for _ in range(n):
        res.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return res

print(fib(7))

expected.description: Must output exact stdout list for Fibonacci computation in plain text.
Must output formatted string result from array reduce without explanations.
Must output compiled printf value in plain text.
Must execute StringBuilder reversal and output reversed string in plain text.

inputs.code:
i = 1
while True:
    print(f"Iteration {i}")
    i += 1

expected.description: Must strictly follow the rule to output first 20 iterations followed by '...'.
Must strictly cap JavaScript infinite loop at 20 iterations followed by '...'.
